tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for applying for the position. Please talk about your last research experience. What did you learn from it?
tasks.analysis: 中文：感谢您申请这个职位。请谈谈您上一次的研究经历。您从中学到了什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: I see. Imagine you have two tasks: one is urgent (must finish soon), the other is important (needs careful work). If you can only focus on one at a time, which do you choose first? Why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：我明白了。假设你有两项任务：一项是紧急任务（必须尽快完成），另一项是重要任务（需要细致处理）。如果只能一次专注处理一项，你会先选哪项？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: If you need to learn a new skill for this project, would you prefer: a) Watching video tutorials to learn step-by-step, or b) Trying directly and asking questions when stuck? Give a reason for your choice.
tasks.analysis: 中文：若需为这个项目学习一项新技能，你更倾向于：a）观看视频教程，按步骤学习；b）直接尝试，遇到问题时再请教？请说明选择理由。”
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Finally, Some people think AI can completely replace humans in jobs like research. Others believe AI can only assist but not replace people. What do you think?
tasks.analysis: 中文：最后一个问题：有人认为，在研究这类工作中，人工智能（AI）能完全取代人类。也有人认为，AI 只能提供辅助，无法替代人类。你怎么看？
tasks.title: Interview
